verse.name: c1
verse.lines:
I wanna be the good soil,
That Your word falls into
I wanna be the good soil,
Bearing thirty, sixty, a hundred times more fruit

verse.name: b1
verse.lines:
If I choose to die, and I'll find new life
Cause I'm crucified with the living Christ

verse.name: v1a
verse.lines: Let my manner of living be a witness that You're alive

verse.name: v1b
verse.lines: In my life would You have the glory

verse.name: v1c
verse.lines:
The only way I look like You in the living
Is to choose the dying, I choose the dying

verse.name: v1d
verse.lines:
If the fruits gonna come from my life
Then I know that it's gonna come when I die to myself, to myself

verse.name: v1e
verse.lines:
Now I lay me down to sleep
Now it's time to die to me

verse.name: v1f
verse.lines:
My mind was made to think about You
My eyes were made to gaze upon You
My heart was made to love and adore You
My mouth was made to give You the Glory
